package stringsample

import "fmt"

const raw = `line one
line two`

func query(id string) string {
	sql := "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = '" + id + "'"
	path := "/etc/" + id
	url := "https://example.invalid/" + id
	letter := 'q'
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", sql, 3) + path + url + string(letter) + raw
}
